sources.entry: Caplo - Screen recorder and editor with automatic camera moves, cursor effects, canvas, and captions.

summary.one_liner: Caplo is a native macOS screen recorder and video editor that opens each recording in an editor for automatic zoom, cursor effects, canvas layout, captions, and export.
use_cases: record screen demos or tutorials on macOS
add automatic zoom and cursor effects to screen recordings
generate and edit captions for a video
export a recording as MP4, MOV, or GIF
remove background noise and silent pauses from narration
make product demo videos with keystroke overlays
how_to_run: cp Config/Local.xcconfig.example Config/Local.xcconfig # fill in DEVELOPMENT_TEAM

xcodebuild -project Caplo.xcodeproj -scheme Caplo -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CAPLO_APP_IDENTIFIER=com.caplo.buildcheck CAPLO_APP_NAME=CaploBuildCheck build
notable: Opens each recording directly in an editor with auto-generated focus zooms that can be hand-edited on a timeline
On-device caption transcription using the system speech recognition, with per-line editing
Optional keystroke recording shown as keycaps, with a separate keyboard-input permission
Built-in teleprompter that scrolls during recording
Records screen, camera, microphone and system audio together
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later and Xcode 16 or later
Licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial: commercial use is prohibited without a separate license
Signing requires a local development team configuration; the README says the signing config is not committed
